Asset type: ONE square game dialogue portrait, a full new illustration, not a contact sheet. The supplied images depict a FICTIONAL character from the game's own 3D model and are identity, costume, camera and lighting references.
Primary request: Translate this exact fictional game character into a refined painterly gouache/oil illustration for an early-1500s Finnish castle scene. Keep the character recognizable. Visible soft brushwork and painted skin and fabric, not photographic realism, not a cartoon, not a plastic 3D render.
Input images: image 1 is the primary reference for the game camera direction and candlelit chapel lighting; images 2 and 3 are identity/costume references in neutral light. Do NOT use the opposite angle from images 2/3.

Slightly elevated camera looking down, three-quarter head turned towards the LEFT OF THE IMAGE, like image 1. Both eyes visible, gaze directed slightly down and left. Do not make a frontal portrait. Plain, soft, deep warm-brown chapel gloom fills all the way to the four square edges; no recognizable furniture, candles, symbols or other objects in the backdrop. Opaque background. Do not fade or mask the image edges; the game will apply its own radial mask.
Lighting: warm dim amber candlelight and soft deep shadows from the same direction as image 1, but render the eyes, brow and mouth clearly enough to read the expression at about 85–95 pixels wide. Restrained warm highlights, no dramatic rim light. Calm old travel-journal mood.
Constraints: exactly one fictional person, no text, no frame, no border, no watermark, no captions. No resemblance to any named real person or actor. No modern clothing, no jewelry invented beyond the model, no hands. Square 1:1 PNG-style painted asset, requested delivery 1024×1024.
Subject: The castle chaplain, about 60 years old. Preserve the narrow angular face and long straight nose, warm brown eyes, short close-cropped GRAY hair, heavy gray eyebrows, clean-shaven chin, and slightly prominent ears of the provided fictional model. Add only modest age lines appropriate to about 60, without changing the facial proportions or hairline. Dark charcoal robe/tunic with muted brown edge trim and the pale vertical front insert with brown closures visible in the model; do not replace it with a modern clergy collar.
Expression: neutral, calm and kind. Relaxed mouth with a very slight softening at the corners, attentive gentle eyes, no large smile. The face is the focus.

neutralCorrection.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: ONE completely new square painted dialogue portrait for the same fictional castle chaplain in the attached primary portrait.
Image roles: image 1 is the exact identity, costume, light, composition, age, head pose and painting-style anchor; image 2 is the original in-game model's camera and warm chapel lighting; image 3 is the original model's identity in neutral lighting.
Generate the entire illustration anew. Preserve exactly the man's narrow angular face, straight long nose, brown eyes, clean-shaven face, short gray hair, gray eyebrow thickness, ears, mature age about 60, dark robe, brown trim, pale central insert and brown closure. Keep identical head size and location, same slightly elevated view and head turned down-left, same shoulders and crop, same amber highlights from image left, same dark warm-brown fully opaque background to every square edge.
The only correction is NEUTRAL GENTLENESS: the primary image's brow reads too stern. Relax the inner eyebrow ends and the glabella completely so there is no frown; make the eyes soft, patient and attentive, while retaining the model's thick gray eyebrows. Keep the mouth closed with a small restrained reassuring smile in the corners, not a broad smile and no visible teeth. He is a calm kind chaplain listening peacefully, not reprimanding. This gentle neutral expression must remain clear at roughly 90 px wide.
Style: preserve the same restrained painterly gouache/oil brushwork, warm candlelit palette and fictional-character likeness. No photography, no cartoon, no smooth plastic render, no younger face, no changed hairline or pose.
No words, no frame, no border, no props or hands, no transparent or feathered edges, no ready-made vignette. The game applies its own radial fade. Square 1:1 opaque portrait for a 1024×1024 PNG.
